questions.question: Why did the LORD tell Gideon he had too many men to fight the Midianites?

answers.text: So Israel would not say their own hand saved them
So Midian would not see them coming from far off
So the march to the valley would go faster

questions.question: God chose Gideon's army by how the men drank. How many lapped the water with their hands to their mouths?
Before attacking the Midianite camp, Gideon gave each of his three hundred men a horn and a large jar. What was inside each jar?
When Gideon's three hundred men blew their horns around the Midianite camp, what did the LORD do?

answers.text: Turned the men against one another
Sent hail down on their tents
